notes.method: phaseCorrelate on band rows100-420 cols700-1900 (ceiling above the sight), scope band rows660-820 cols1200-1360 (correlates 0.58-1.0 with periph, not independent); +y = view kicks up; time from frame timestamps (all clips ~59.5 fps effective although r_frame_rate says 120); firing window = first motion to start of recovery; shot grid = fitted periodic phase, not muzzle flash; cycles skip first 2; plateau = after smoothed climb reaches 90% of max

zoom_relative_to_CCO_view.method: template match of pre-fire world strip vs Off frame over scale; PP-19 On 1.49-1.50, PW5A3 On 1.99-2.05, PVQ 2.04-2.08; cross-check: total climb px/zoom equal across sights
